items.title: Migrate Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Java code with AWS Transform custom
items.summary: Migrating an enterprise Java application from Oracle to PostgreSQL is often described as a database project — but with tools like AWS Transform custom, most of the real work lands in the application code. A large Java or Kotlin codebase can carry thousands of Oracle-specific SQL statements, Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) type assumptions, object-relational mapping […]

items.title: Right-Size AWS Transform MGN Replication Servers
items.summary: Migration teams need a consistent way to right-size AWS Transform MGN replication servers when a wave includes many source servers. The challenge grows when source servers range from small systems to workloads with several tebibytes of provisioned disk capacity.
